Since 1998, customers have chosen Orange Logic because it adapts to their business instead of asking their business to adapt to the DAM.

- **Work the way your teams already do.** Adapt workflows, metadata, permissions, and experiences without creating new silos.
- **Manage the full content lifecycle in one place.** Connect DAM, MAM, rights, workflows, and delivery on one platform.
- **Put AI to work with context.** Use AI agents and automation that understand content, metadata, rights, permissions, and business rules.
- **Reduce risk without slowing work.** Keep approvals, usage rights, access controls, and governance connected to every asset.
- **Scale without replatforming.** Support new teams, use cases, and millions of assets on the same governed foundation.

## Frequently Asked Questions

#### Is Orange Logic a DAM, MAM, or content orchestration platform?

Orange Logic starts with enterprise digital asset management and extends across media asset management, rights, workflows, AI, governance, and content delivery. The result is one platform for managing and orchestrating content across its full lifecycle instead of adding another system for every new use case.

#### What makes Orange Logic different from a traditional enterprise DAM?

Traditional DAMs primarily organize, govern, and distribute assets. Orange Logic goes further by connecting content, media, rights, workflows, AI, and delivery on one platform that can adapt to how different teams work. That means fewer handoffs, fewer disconnected systems, and more of the content lifecycle managed in one place.

#### What does Orange Logic mean by agentic content orchestration?

Agentic content orchestration means AI can do more than generate or tag content. Orange Logic agents can work with the context around an asset—including metadata, rights, permissions, workflows, and business rules—to search, enrich, review, route, and act on content while staying within the same governance as your teams.

#### Can one platform support both marketing content and complex video operations?

Yes. Orange Logic manages images, documents, creative files, video, audio, and production media on the same governed foundation. Marketing teams can manage campaigns and brand assets while media teams work with proxies, high-resolution originals, frame-accurate review, video intelligence, and archives without creating a separate content silo.

#### Do we have to move all of our content into Orange Logic?

No. Orange Logic can manage content in the cloud while also extending search, metadata, permissions, and governance to media that remains on existing NAS or SAN storage. Teams can keep high-resolution files and established production workflows in place while making that content discoverable and usable across the enterprise.

#### Can Orange Logic support different teams without creating more silos?

Yes. Different teams, brands, regions, and partners can have experiences tailored to the content, navigation, workflows, and permissions they need while working from the same governed content foundation. Teams get an experience that fits how they work without duplicating assets or standing up another DAM.

#### How does Orange Logic keep content, AI, and access governed at enterprise scale?

Governance stays connected to the content throughout its lifecycle. Permissions, rights, approvals, usage rules, and audit history determine what people—and AI agents—can see and do, helping enterprises expand automation, content access, and new use cases without giving up control.
